description:
161 Recruiting Light Rail Advertising

 
This IS NOT a solicitation.  This is a NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT using Federal Acquisition Regulation FAR Part 6.302-1; only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.

The 161st ARW Arizona Air National Guard, 3200E Old Tower Rd Phoenix, AZ 85034 has a requirement to provide transit advertising for the Goldwater ANG Base/161ARW, AZANG. The government will provide the design. The contractor shall provide; a minimum of three (3) different full train wrap ads (six (6) total wrap ads), a minimum of one (1) center section train wrap ad (two (2) total ads), and a minimum of three (3) platform kiosk ads located at stations 17 (Central Ave N/O Van Buren St), 18 (1st Ave N/O Van Buren St), and 40 (Veterans Way W/O College Ave). This will provide advertising and increase AZANG awareness throughout the city of Phoenix and surrounding areas. Advertisements shall be per-approved by AZANG prior to use.

The Arizona Air National Guard intends to award a sole source, firm fixed price contract to Outfront Media Inc.  Only one responsible vendor is currently on contract with the Phoenix Light Rail (Valley Metro.) To advertise with them, that sole source will need to be utilized, pursuant to FAR 6.302-1(2)(i)(B).  A contract will be awarded under the Other than Full and Open Competition procedures, pursuant to FAR 13.106-1(b)(1). This is not a request for competitive proposals.

CLIN 0001:

Train advertisement, full wrap with 24 weeks displayed IAW STATEMENT OF OBJECTIVE

Asset Type: ADVERTISEMENT

Pricing Arrangement: Firm Fixed Price

Quantity:  3 Each

CLIN 0002:

Train advertisement, full center section wrap with 24 weeks displayed IAW STATEMENT OF OBJECTIVE

Asset Type: ADVERTISEMENT

Pricing Arrangement: Firm Fixed Price

Quantity:  1 Each

CLIN 0003:

platform kiosk advertisements with 24 weeks displayed IAW STATEMENT OF OBJECTIVE

Asset Type: ADVERTISEMENT Pricing Arrangement:

Firm Fixed Price

Quantity:  3 Each

PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE:
Twenty-four (24) week with a period of performance from April 20, 2026 to October 4, 2026

The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price sole source contract to:
OUTFRONT MEDIA INC
90 PARK AVE FL 9
NEW YORK, NEW YORK 10016-1310


The associated North America Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 541890 and the Business Size Standard is $19M.

For questions concerning this Notice of Intent, contact MSgt Terry Ahseln at terry.ahseln.1@us.af mil. Posting date of this Special Notice is 19 MAR 2026.

Scope of Work/Statement of Objectives:

Deliver, install and display components as described above.

The location of contract performance is as follows:

161 ARW/Goldwater ANG Base

3200 E Old Tower Rd

Phoenix, AZ 85034

Determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon response to this notice is solely within the discretion of the government.
NO TELEPHONE REQUESTS WILL BE HONORED.
